We’re looking for a Part-Time Waiter to join our Michelin-starred restaurant. This is an opportunity to be part of a tight-knit team that values professionalism, hospitality, and a passion for great food and wine.

What we offer:

Flexible schedule based on availability

Competitive salary based on experience

Tips split evenly across the team

Eligibility for our biannual work/study grant

A respectful, team-oriented, aggression-free work environment

What we’re looking for:

Passion, humor & good vibes

Ability to work in an energetic fine dining setting

Genuine interest in connecting with guests

Fluent in English (Danish is a plus, but not required)

A team player looking for a place to grow

Join Alouette as a Full Time Waiter and become part of a Michelin-starred team dedicated to purpose-driven hospitality, world-class dining, and deep product knowledge. We offer a 3.5-day workweek (Wednesday to Saturday, with Sunday to Tuesday off), a competitive salary based on experience, and tips split evenly across the team. You’ll have access to private health insurance, eligibility pension after one year, five weeks of paid vacation, and eligibility to apply for our biannual work and study grant.

Most importantly, you’ll join a respectful, team-oriented, aggression-free workplace where you can grow and thrive.

We’re looking for someone with at least one year of experience from a Fine Dining restaurant who brings passion, humor, and good vibes to the floor.

You should love wine, coffee, and all things beverage, and you genuinely enjoy connecting with guests. You’re fluent in English (Danish is a plus but not required), and you’re a team player who is looking for a place to develop your skills while being part of something meaningful.

At Alouette, we take pride in working closely with local farmers and makers, creating a dining experience rooted in purpose, people, planet, and profit, and we believe team culture is just as important as the guest experience.

If this sounds like you, send us your CV and a short message about yourself and why you want to work at Alouette.

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.occupation: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

• 
You are a qualified carpenter

• 
You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

• 
You have a valid driving licence

• 
You can communicate in English

• 
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

• 
A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

• 
Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

• 
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

• 
Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

• 
Pension scheme

• 
Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

• 
Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

jobs.occupation: Kitchen assistant, kitchen help - or trained chef
jobs.description:
Attention ladies & gents in Aarhus, or close by  

We are looking for a chef - kitchen assistant or kitchenhelp to our french bistro.

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly busy.  

Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have.

Klassisk Bistro 65, being the characteristic charming French bistro   https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Who we are;

We are a wonderful diverse team in nationalities and cultures, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organisation is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We are looking for the following staff;

Experienced chefs, that have years behind a stow and is used to busy and high pressure service. You are able to keep calm, move fast, make nice food & keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

Kitchen help, that have min. 6 months experience working in kitchens, helping out with prep for service as well as helping out as a waiter. You are willing to do a lot of helpful stuff when getting ready for service.

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. 

Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in following the company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company. We expect of you to be responsible and meet on time and not report sick every second day due to hangovers.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid)

·       We teach you, first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       Chance to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli

·       Maybe you join our restaurant Smukfisk at SmukFest festival in Skanderborg

·       Chance to participate in Danish Oyester Cup, when we attend this event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay untill your shift ends at night. Its a non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role & if you seek parttime or full time.

If your headder is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

jobs.occupation: KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL SPISEHUSET DRAGØR SEJLKLUB
jobs.description:
Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst køkken souschef til en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Om restauranten

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub ligger ved Dragør Havn i en historisk bygning fra 1863. Restauranten har fokus på god mad, god service og en hyggelig atmosfære. Køkkenet står for den daglige restaurantdrift samt selskaber og arrangementer, og der er derfor fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde i køkkenet.

Som køkken souschef bliver du en central del af den daglige køkkendrift og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og det øvrige køkkenpersonale. Stillingen indebærer både praktisk køkkenarbejde samt ansvar for koordinering og ledelse af køkkenpersonalet.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige ledelse og koordinering

• 
Varetage køkkendriften ved køkkenchefens fravær

• 
Fordele og koordinere arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

• 
Planlægge mise en place og øvrig forberedelse

• 
Deltage aktivt i madlavning og produktion

• 
Sikre kvalitet, smag og ensartethed i retterne

• 
Oplære og vejlede nye medarbejdere

• 
Medvirke til planlægning af bemanding og arbejdsflow

• 
Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lager og råvareforbrug

• 
Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv drift under både almindelig service og selskaber

Vi søger dig, der

• 
Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

• 
Har erfaring som souschef, køkkenansvarlig, teamleder eller tilsvarende

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering eller ledelse af køkkenpersonale

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for køkkendriften

• 
Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Kan bevare overblikket under travle services

• 
Har fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Dansk er en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

• 
En central rolle med ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift

• 
Tæt samarbejde med køkkenchef og øvrigt personale

• 
Varierende arbejdsopgaver inden for restaurant- og selskabsdrift

• 
Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

• 
Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

• 
Ansættelse på almindelige danske vilkår

Arbejdstiden kan omfatte dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR SPISEHUSET DRAGØR SEJLKLUB

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub is looking for an experienced and responsible Kitchen Sous Chef for a permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

About the restaurant

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub is located at Dragør Harbour in a historic building dating from 1863. The restaurant focuses on good food, good service and a welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen is responsible for daily restaurant service as well as private functions and events, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and teamwork.

As Kitchen Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily kitchen operation and work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. The position includes both practical kitchen work and responsibility for coordinating and supervising kitchen staff.

Main responsibilities

• 
Assist the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

• 
Take responsibility for the kitchen operation when the Head Chef is absent

• 
Distribute and coordinate tasks among kitchen staff

• 
Plan mise en place and other preparation

• 
Take an active part in cooking and food production

• 
Ensure quality, taste and consistency of dishes

• 
Train and guide new employees

• 
Assist with staffing and workflow planning

• 
Monitor deliveries, stock and ingredient usage

• 
Ensure compliance with food hygiene and food safety requirements

• 
Contribute to efficient operations during both regular service and private functions

About you

• 
Relevant professional kitchen experience

• 
Experience as a Sous Chef, Kitchen Supervisor, Team Leader or similar

• 
Experience coordinating or supervising kitchen staff

• 
Able to work independently and take responsibility for kitchen operations

• 
Organised, reliable and responsible

• 
Able to remain calm during busy services

• 
Focused on quality, efficiency and food safety

• 
Able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage.

We offer

• 
Permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

• 
A central role with responsibility for daily kitchen operations

• 
Close cooperation with the Head Chef and kitchen team

• 
Varied duties within restaurant and private-function operations

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
Salary based on experience and qualifications

• 
Employment on ordinary Danish terms

Working hours may include daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

FragtDK ApS is experiencing increased demand and is therefore looking for 2–4 new, experienced, and reliable drivers holding a Category CE driving licence.

Fixed shifts with predictable working hours

Salary based on qualifications

Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• 
During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• 
You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• 
You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

• 
You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• 
You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• 
You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• 
During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• 
During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

• 
You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• 
After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• 
You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• 
You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• 
You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• 
You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• 
You are a team player with strong communication skills

• 
You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• 
You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.
